# BAD-057 — Fix collabweb.js's stale note that booth.js tests collabPin

## Brief
web/collabweb.js:82 says 'collabPin is also what booth.js tests to know a scene is in a room', but no booth file (booth.js before or after the BAD-045 split) reads collabPin; every reader is inside collabweb.js. collabweb.js is outside BAD-045's deliverables, so the comment was left as is.

Evidence: grep -n collabPin web/*.js: only web/collabweb.js (75, 82, 83, 194, 242, 257, 311, 333, 398); grep of web/booth.js at origin/main 5751929 finds none.
